FCC clears SpaceX to deploy up to 1 million Starmind satellites

The FCC has authorized SpaceX to deploy up to 1 million Starmind satellites to process AI data as orbital data centers. SpaceX is targeting its first launches in 2027, with the full constellation operating by 2040. Google and Blue Origin are also working on AI infrastructure in space, and Boston Consulting Group estimates costs will stay well above ground-based data centers for now.

Reported by The Decoder; BBC; CNBC; Engadget. Written by AI.
